# Borked3DS-rpi PGO profile (Raspberry Pi 5)
#
# Files in this folder:
#   borked3ds.proftext.xz         LLVM profile in text format, compressed (read by llvm-profdata)
#   borked3ds.proftext.xz.sha256  checksum, verified by borked3ds.sh before use
#   PROFIL.txt                    this file
#
# borked3ds.sh (pi5 target) converts the profile with the llvm-profdata of the same version as
# Clang, then builds with -fprofile-use. If anything goes wrong, it builds without PGO, as before.
# BORKED3DS_NO_PGO=1 forces a build without PGO.
#
# The key=value lines below are read by borked3ds.sh: keep their names unchanged.

commit_profil=1a105e20b
clang=19.1.7 (Debian 13 trixie)
date=2026-11-16
options=-mcpu=cortex-a76+crypto -O3, ThinLTO, -fprofile-generate (IR-level PGO)

# Paths of the tree in which the profile was recorded. Local functions (static, anonymous
# namespaces, lambdas) are named "<source path>;<name>" in the profile; borked3ds.sh replaces
# these prefixes with the paths of its own tree before conversion, otherwise Clang cannot match them.
prefixe_sources=/home/pi/borked3ds_pgo/src/
prefixe_build=/home/pi/borked3ds_pgo/build_gen/

# Training: 7 normal play sessions (automatic frame pacing), each ended with Exit:
#   Luigi's Mansion 2 (warm cache x2, and cold without the shader cache), Castlevania Mirror of
#   Fate, Kid Icarus Uprising, Super Smash Bros, Metroid Samus Returns. Renderer: Vulkan.
#   OpenGL-specific code is not in the profile (compiled as cold code).
#
# Measurements (Pi 5 at 3 GHz, fixed workload, CPU time of the emulation thread, PGO binary
# against the standard -march=armv8.2-a+crc+crypto binary):
#   Luigi's Mansion 2                  -11 %   (35.0 % -> 31.1 %, 3 runs each)
#   Zelda (not in the profile)         -17 %   (40.4 % -> 33.3 % and 33.8 %)
#   Sonic Lost World (not in profile)  -8.5 %  (13.0 % -> 11.9 %)
#
# Regenerating the profile (after large code changes):
#   1. instrumented build: same options plus -fprofile-generate, installed in place of the
#      normal binary;
#   2. play a few sessions with LLVM_PROFILE_FILE=<folder>/borked3ds-%m.profraw on the launch
#      line, and quit with Exit or Ctrl+Q (never with a signal: main.cpp intercepts SIGINT and
#      SIGTERM, and the profile would not be written);
#   3. llvm-profdata merge -o borked3ds.profdata <folder>/*.profraw
#      llvm-profdata merge --text -o borked3ds.proftext borked3ds.profdata
#      xz -9 borked3ds.proftext ; sha256sum borked3ds.proftext.xz > borked3ds.proftext.xz.sha256
#   4. replace the files in this folder and update commit_profil, prefixe_sources (root of the
#      source tree, with a trailing /) and prefixe_build (build folder).
